settings.title: Windows & tabs
settings.desc: Where the PR Inbox, Calendar, Slack threads, Todos, Notes and file viewers open.
settings.modeHint: Auto: on one screen everything opens as a tab of the main window. With a second screen, the PR Inbox, Mentions, Calendar, Delivery Radar and Slack threads open in their own window.
settings.dockOnUnplug: Dock windows back as tabs when a screen is unplugged
settings.dockOnUnplugHint: When the second screen goes away, its PR Inbox / Calendar / Slack… windows come back into the main window as tabs.
settings.permFloat: Pop up approval windows while Devdy is in the background
settings.permFloatHint: With Devdy in front, permission requests are answered in the main window. Off: only a notification while you're in another app.

toast.docked: Screen unplugged: {n} window moved back into tabs | Screen unplugged: {n} windows moved back into tabs
